_schema: qa/typed/review.json v1: certification of decision-model gold labels. status=reviewed requires EVERY scenario in the label source covered by a style/choice entry whose labels_sha256 matches the source bytes, with reviewer named and rationale_ok true. The reviewer field records WHO reviewed (a human expert, or a model review pass with its identity stated); human expert sign-off, when performed, is listed in `human_review`. coverage_ack.{qid} lists per-criterion acknowledgments {criterion, reviewer, note, source_sha256} for train-uncovered criteria (R7); any label-source edit voids coverage for the changed bytes (re-review and re-record the sha). Choice entries use {scenario_id, label, reviewer, label_ok, source_sha256} against choice.jsonl bytes (R8 advisory). tacit_calibrate.py refuses to recommend a floor until this ledger certifies derive_style_labels.py.

human_review.note: No human expert reviewed these labels. The reviewer above is a model review pass; treat it as an independent check, not expert sign-off. Blind human audit inputs: data/benchmark-runs/style-audit/holdout-blind.jsonl + rubric.md.

method: All 169 labels re-derived from the scenario description under the rubric by 4 independent model review passes (agents with fresh context, not the label author); every disputed row adjudicated against its description text. 7 dispute(s) raised; 7 adjudicated.
